title: Descended overlap transitions and cartesian intersection lifts
statement: Let $p:X\to Y$ be an fpqc singleton of schemes [def-pc-scheme, def-weil-pbc-fpqc-covering], let $V\to X$ have a transport descent datum $D$ [def-pd-descent-datum], and let $(U_i)_{i\in I}$ be any family of open subschemes of $V$ (not necessarily covering). Suppose $E_i$ is a descent datum on $U_i\to X$, its transports followed by $U_i\to V$ equal the transports of $D$ followed from the same test point, and there are schemes $W_i\to Y$ and maps $q_i:U_i\to W_i$ with cartesian squares over $p$ [def-pc-fibre-product], such that each $q_i$ is invariant under all transports of $E_i$. Then there exist schemes $Z_{ik}$, open immersions $f_{ik}:Z_{ik}\to W_i$ [def-weil-open-immersion], and maps $t_{ik}:Z_{ik}\to Z_{ki}$, with $f_{ii}$ an isomorphism and $t_{ii}$ the identity. There exist maps $t'_{ikl}:Z_{ik}\times_{W_i}Z_{il}\to Z_{kl}\times_{W_k}Z_{ki}$ whose second projection equals the first projection followed by $t_{ik}$, and $t'_{ikl}t'_{kli}t'_{lik}$ is the identity (composition in the order traversed). For each $i,k$ there is a map $r_{ik}:U_i\times_V U_k\to Z_{ik}$ making the square with first projection to $U_i$, $f_{ik}$ and $q_i$ cartesian, and $r_{ik}$ followed by $t_{ik}$ and $f_{ki}$ equals the second projection followed by $q_k$. No ambient scheme or its structure map is asserted.

proof.text: For each i,k take the open inverse image of U_k in U_i. Compatibility with D and inverse transport show this open is invariant under E_i. The pullback square identifies E_i with the canonical datum because transport preserves q_i. Base change of the singleton p makes q_i fpqc. Descent of opens gives a unique open O_ik in W_i whose pullback is the intersection. Put Z(i,k)=O_ik and f i k its open inclusion. Uniqueness for the diagonal gives O_ii=W_i, so f i i is an isomorphism. The descended-open pullback square gives r i k and its cartesian square.

The identity on the common intersection identifies the pullbacks of Z(i,k) and Z(k,i), compatibly with the canonical data. Apply the morphism descent bijection to descend this identity to t i k and its inverse to t k i. Injectivity proves the inverse equations and t i i=identity. By construction r i k followed by t i k and f k i equals the second projection followed by q k.

Uniqueness of descended opens identifies the triple-overlap domains after restricting the transitions. Their cartesian universal properties define the maps t prime with the required second-projection equation. After fpqc base change their cyclic composite is the identity on the triple intersection; injectivity of morphism descent gives the cyclic cocycle. Empty index sets and empty opens give empty families and empty descended opens, respectively. This constructs local overlap data only, without taking a colimit or constructing its map to the base.

theorem exists_descended_overlap_glue_data
    {X Y : Scheme.{u}} {p : X ⟶ Y}
    (hp : Presieve.singleton p ∈ Scheme.fpqcPrecoverage Y)
    {V : Over X} (D : Over.DescentDatum p V)
    {I : Type u} (U : I → V.left.Opens)
    (E : ∀ i, Over.DescentDatum p (Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)))
    (hcompat : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ (U i).ι =
        (D.transport f₁ f₂ h (Over.homMk (a.left ≫ (U i).ι)
          (by simpa only [Over.mk_hom, Category.assoc] using Over.w a))).left)
    (W : I → Over Y) (q : ∀ i, (U i).toScheme ⟶ (W i).left)
    (hcart : ∀ i, IsPullback (q i) ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom) (W i).hom p)
    (hinv : ∀ (i : I) {T : Scheme.{u}} (f₁ f₂ : T ⟶ X)
      (h : f₁ ≫ p = f₂ ≫ p) (a : Over.mk f₁ ⟶ Over.mk ((U i).ι ≫ V.hom)),
      ((E i).transport f₁ f₂ h a).left ≫ q i = a.left ≫ q i) :
    ∃ (Z : I × I → Scheme.{u}) (f : ∀ i k, Z (i, k) ⟶ (W i).left)
      (t : ∀ i k, Z (i, k) ⟶ Z (k, i)),
      (∀ i k, IsOpenImmersion (f i k)) ∧
      (∀ i, IsIso (f i i)) ∧
      (∀ i, t i i = 𝟙 _) ∧
      (∃ (t' : ∀ i k l, Limits.pullback (f i k) (f i l) ⟶ Limits.pullback (f k l) (f k i)),
        (∀ i k l, t' i k l ≫ pullback.snd _ _ = pullback.fst _ _ ≫ t i k) ∧
        (∀ i k l, t' i k l ≫ t' k l i ≫ t' l i k = 𝟙 _)) ∧
      (∀ i k, ∃ (r : Limits.pullback (U i).ι (U k).ι ⟶ Z (i, k)),
        IsPullback r (pullback.fst (U i).ι (U k).ι) (f i k) (q i) ∧
        r ≫ t i k ≫ f k i = pullback.snd (U i).ι (U k).ι ≫ q k)
